what_happened: In job hac3, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The reading's test shape did not match what the user meant. The user fixed it. After landing the cutover job in a scratch repository, build one job branch whose range holds an intervention commit, a records-only commit and then the job's landing commit. Land it through land_pr with a squash merge, as this repository does. Assert that the squash commit has no Athena- lines and that `athena check --history` and `--attribution` pass on it. Assert that each of the three commits reachable through the landing record's second parent has no Athena- lines. Assert that the landing record classifies them as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing. Trailers must also be stripped in squash_text for post-C0 landings. The event does not record what the first reading wrote.
cause: The reading stage works from the request text and has no step that makes a test for a landing or history check use a realistic branch. Such a branch holds mixed commit kinds (intervention, records-only, job landing). It must also be landed the way this repository lands, by squash merge through land_pr. Without that, the reading's test shape covers only simple job commits or a different merge path. The squash path, which flattens commits and carries trailers, goes untested. The class of branch shapes the check must survive is not listed anywhere the reading can consult, so the user had to supply it.
prevention: Add a default to the reading stage. Any criterion on a landing, history or attribution check must name a test fixture that uses a realistic branch. That branch has at least one intervention commit, one records-only commit and the job landing commit. It is landed by the same path used in this repository (land_pr with squash merge). The criterion must assert the outcome on the squash commit, on each constituent commit, and on the landing record's classification. The same default requires the reading to state how trailer stripping behaves in the squash text.
proposed_request: Add a test for the cutover import and landing behavior that uses a realistic branch. In a scratch repository, land the cutover job. Then build one job branch holding an intervention commit (commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer) and the job's landing commit, and land it through land_pr with a squash merge. Assert that the squash commit on the base has no Athena- lines. Assert that `athena check --history` and `athena check --attribution` pass on it. Assert that each of the three commits in the pull request, reachable from the records branch through the landing record's second parent, has no Athena- lines. Assert that the landing record classifies them as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing. Strip trailers in squash_text for post-C0 landings. Do not change anything else.
